description: Transfer and boot size of what the viewer ships, measured by scripts/perf-ratchet/measure-bundle.mjs from the build job's artifacts: raw bytes of the engine WASM, of the viewer's main entry chunk, of every JS file dist/index.html loads eagerly (eager bytes are the blocking ceiling, #7002) and of the parser worker's own chunk, which every cold load fetches, compiles and evaluates before it can parse. Everything is gated raw because brotli-11 does not track its input smoothly: the viewer JS jumps by ~0.5% on a same-length timestamp change (#7007), and edits that left the engine WASM's raw size unchanged moved its brotli size by -1,074 and +1,547 bytes. Brotli sizes, the engine WASM's among them, are reported, not gated. Raising a ceiling is a human PR with a justification (docs/guide/performance.md, 'Perf ratchet ceilings'); lowering is the daily perf-ratchet-lower.yml job.
